$comment: PLATE REGISTER — one illustration per game, named explicitly.
Until 2026-09 plates were matched to games by the order of files in a folder; one
stale download made Jan-ken print the Set-dilth picture in every edition. A plate
is now assigned here, by gameId, and 04_BUILD/make_plates.py, interior.py and
qa_book.py all refuse a register in which two games share one image.
kind: ai-generated | public-domain | cc0 | drawn (a board drawn for this book from its own diagram data) | pending-replacement (a build blocker).

2026-09-26 recovery: the 11 pending plates (audit WG-003, WG-033, WG-034) were replaced with public-domain or CC0 images of the equipment and two boards drawn from the diagram data; provenance in 07_ASSETS/plates/pd/README.md and 07_ASSETS/plates/drawn/README.md.
